compatibility_notes: 383/393-update checkpoints predate timeout/spawn contract changes; train_01 lacks the new T1 settlement. They cannot strictly resume as the current task.
Single/multi-GPU strict resume requires identical topology, per-rank environment counts, seed and training contracts.
Performance execution options are recorded separately from semantic training contracts; historic performance reports precede the new T1.
Native training uses pmt / Isaac Sim 5.1; GUI playback uses Isaac Sim 6.0.1 with Isaac Lab 2.3.2 compatibility.
remaining_validation: GPU/NCCL regression and Isaac simulation were not rerun during this archival task.
Recovery pool/reward remains deferred by the existing user scope.
Full terrain/difficulty success evaluation, fixed 30-second benchmark, export and convergence are not established.
The active new-T1 run is incomplete at snapshot time; old-T1 training analysis does not measure new-T1 policy quality.
Historical reports retain their original measurements; later source edits are not retroactively covered by those reports.
